LESSON: AUDITORY LISTENING

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.6: Auditory LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Auditory LISTENING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recall letter sounds in class.
2. Take pleasure in listening to sounds in the environment. letter names and fishing games. exploring their prior experience. heard at home or on the way to school. Core-competence developed: Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Recall letter sounds in class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recall letter sounds in class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Take pleasure in listening to sounds in the environment. letter names and fishing games. exploring their prior experience. heard at home or on the way to school. Core-competence developed: Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to take pleasure in listening to sounds in the environment. letter names and fishing games. exploring their prior experience. heard at home or on the way to school. Core-competence developed: Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Auditory LISTENING.
2. Explain Auditory LISTENING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Auditory LISTENING.
4. Show that you can: Recall letter sounds in class.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Auditory LISTENING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Auditory LISTENING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Recall letter sounds in class.
2. Take pleasure in listening to sounds in the environment. letter names and fishing games. exploring their prior experience. heard at home or on the way to school. Core-competence developed: Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
